_comment: THE PROSE FLOOR. tools/prose_floor.py enforces this manifest over every
markdown file at the repository root and in docs/ (docs/walks/ and
modules/ are out of scope in v1). Owner ruling 2026-08-26: reader-facing
prose is terse; rationale and history live in records (BLUEPRINT,
KNOWN-ISSUES, the private program repo, the vault) - never inline, and
records never ship to the public mirror. The acceptance bar: a reader
new to the project follows the docs without stumbling on shorthand,
Every in-scope file appears under budgets (max words) or exempt (with a
reason). An unlisted file FAILS the gate: new documents declare their
budget in the same change that adds them. Budgets only ratchet down.
per-step QUICKSTART detail is a private record: the program records repo docs/records/QUICKSTART-APPENDIX.md (owner ruling 2026-08-26); records never ship to the public mirror

exempt.KNOWN-ISSUES.md: append-only register; entries are the record
exempt.COMPARISON.md: claims-audit register; rows are the record
exempt.BLUEPRINT.md: the rationale home; records live here by design
